not_covered.text: Saudi Arabia launches an airstrike at a market in Al Hazm, Al-Jawf Governorate, Yemen, killing 14 civilians and wounding ten more.

not_covered.topic: 2026 Iran war fuel crisis, Canada and the 2026 Iran war
not_covered.text: The Bank of Canada raises its policy interest rate by 25 basis points to 2.5%, its first increase since July 2023, citing persistent inflation driven partly by higher oil and gasoline prices linked to the Iran war.

Jio Platforms raises US$3.2 billion in India's largest-ever initial public offering (IPO), attracting about $77 billion in bids and becoming the country's most-subscribed IPO before its stock-market debut in Mumbai.

not_covered.topic: Rwanda–United States relations, Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict
not_covered.text: The United States imposes sanctions on the Rwandan ministry of defence over its role in the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, alleging that Rwanda is backing the M23 rebels to fight against Congolese forces.
A youth armed with two knives wounds a police officer outside the Israeli embassy in Belgrade, Serbia, before being shot and killed.
British far-right activist Tommy Robinson is convicted of harassing two journalists and causing them to fear violence.
In baseball, the Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks defeat the Yokohama DeNA BayStars in four games to win its 13th Japan Series championship.
